messages.subject: specifying multiplier with web data
parts:
I have trapping web data for small mammals over 4 nights. I entered the
data as I would for point transects with Visits=4 and the multiplier as
"/". However, wouldn't Visits=1 with trapping web data because I am using
1st captures only (at this point in the analysis)?

messages.author: 5140016d70f6ba82
messages.subject: Re: specifying multiplier with web data
parts:
John F Lehmkuhl wrote:
> > I have trapping web data for small mammals over 4 nights. I entered the
> > data as I would for point transects with Visits=4 and the multiplier as
> > "/". However, wouldn't Visits=1 with trapping web data because I am using
> > 1st captures only (at this point in the analysis)?
> >

Correct. With the point transect example, these would be 4 independent
samples of the same point. In the
trapping web example, you are removing seen animals at each occasion.
These are then "summed" for the
equivalent of a single visit.
